text:
owen: Heads-up: nightly billing for customer 'Veridian Labs' (cust_4401) produced two invoices and the smaller one omitted the VAT adjustment line. inv_229123A shows €10,720 but inv_229123B shows €9,800. The missing VAT line should be 9% (~€920). Job: bill-2026-03-29-02 batch#12. @finance-team :warning:

priya: tax-bot flagged a mismatch when reconciling totals; it created a ticket SPT-1601. tax-bot: "Invoice totals mismatch detected for cust_4401: 2 invoices in batch, one missing tax_line code=VAT_EU_9pct"

cassie: quick db check: ```SELECT id, amount_cents, line_items, metadata->>'run_id' from invoices WHERE customer_id='cust_4401' AND created_at > '2026-03-29';```
Result:
- inv_229123A | 1072000 | [{usage:1000000, vat:92000}] | run=run-8042
- inv_229123B | 980000  | [{usage:980000}]        | run=run-8042-retry

owen: logs show billing worker failed when calling pdf-generator (timeout) then retried. The retry path created a fresh invoice but didn't attach optional tax adjustments. Looks like attach_tax_line() is skipped for retry runs due to a guard check. File: billing/adjustments/tax_attach.py:88

priya: Are payments captured? Need to know whether to refund or create credit.

tax-bot: payment status: inv_229123A captured=false, inv_229123B captured=false. No captures.

cassie: Found error in logs: "KeyError: 'vat_rate'" when executing attach_tax_line on first attempt, which triggered a retry. On retry, job_run id changed and the attach step was short-circuited due to a conditional designed to prevent duplicate lines; that conditional is too aggressive and is skipping valid attaches on retries.

owen: Proposed immediate actions: 1) pause exporter for run-8042; 2) mark inv_229123B as void with note 'duplicate created by retry; missing VAT line SPT-1601'; 3) reissue corrected invoice inv_229123C with full lines. Need accounting approval to void.

priya: I approve void of inv_229123B (uncaptured). Please include ticket SPT-1601 and the support thread link. Also add entry to audit log with operator name.

cassie: I'll run void command after 10 minutes to allow support to confirm message hold: ```UPDATE invoices SET status='voided', note='duplicate: retry omitted VAT line; see SPT-1601' WHERE id='inv_229123B';```

eng: long-term fix proposal: make attach_tax_line idempotent using upsert on invoice_line(code) and add a unique constraint on (invoice_id, code). Also make retry preserve job_run or propagate cause so attach step can re-evaluate rather than skip. I'll PR the change and add unit tests for retry semantics.

owen: ops - can you blacklist the retry route for cust_4401 until hotfix?

eng: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/billing/pull/452 - adds idempotent attach, unique constraint on invoice_lines(code), and better error logging. Planning staging deploy in 40m, prod after verification.

ops: paused exporter for run-8042 and flagged batch. Created ticket ENG-BILL-958.

priya: Drafting customer note to Veridian Labs: "Hi - we detected a billing automation issue where a retry created a duplicate invoice missing the VAT adjustment. We'll void the duplicate (inv_229123B) and issue a corrected invoice today. No action needed on your side. Apologies for the confusion."

owen: Please add both invoice IDs and the support ticket link in the message. Also record whether payment gateway shows any pending authorization.

cassie: gateway check: no auths or captures. Good.

priya: Go ahead with void after 10m if no objections. cassie, include audit note and set note field to 'voided duplicate - retry omitted VAT; SPT-1601'.

owen: Thanks everyone. Tagging this for month-end audit and sending support ticket to the reconciliation team. :thumbsup:
